messages:
jamie_cs: Heads-up — running an activation playbook walkthrough for Helios Labs' Dedicated pool tomorrow 9:30am PT. Goal: quota acceptance, autoscale sanity, 30m canary + small load test. Need eng, ops, SRE.

mira_eng: I'll be there. Can you paste the target QPS and token profile? Also any model pinning?

jamie_cs: Target steady-state 1200 tok/s ~20 RPS for their chat model (gptx-8k-quant). Canary will start at 10 RPS, spike to 25 RPS, then steady 20 RPS. Model pinned to gptx-8k-quant:v2.

sam_ops: Autoscale policy ACT-43 will be used: min_instances=2, max_instances=8, scale_up_threshold=70% GPU, cool_down=45s. We should temporarily increase burst buffer to +1 for the canary.

leo_sre: Agree on buffer. I'll add an alert for kv cache thrash and 95th latency > 250ms. If 95p >250ms for two consecutive 5m windows, we pause traffic shift and fallback to hosted-model route.

mira_eng: Load test plan — using locust runner. Command we'll run from perf-nodes: 

```
locust -f helios_locustfile.py --headless -u 30 -r 5 --run-time 30m --csv helios_test
```

We'll ramp users per scenario to hit the token profile.

sam_ops: +1. Make sure to include prefix priming before the canary: run warmup script to populate KV with their top 50 prompts.

jamie_cs: Sarah from Helios will join for the first 15m of canary to watch behaviour and note concerns (renewal touchpoint next month). She flagged a potential renewal risk if latency spikes recur.

sarah_cust: Confirmed. I'll be on. My main asks: SLA >99.5% p99 latency <350ms, and invoice impact threshold for tokens. If we miss SLA twice in 2 weeks, renewal discussion escalates.

leo_sre: Noted. We'll ensure p99 dashboards and an automated postmortem link in the runbook. Also adding runbook step: fallback to model: gptx-8k-quant:v1 if v2 shows regressions.

mira_eng: Quick check — quant profile applied? v2 uses int8-quant-profile-B, which is more memory efficient but may increase latency slightly. I'll prepare a variant with int8-latency-optimized flags.

jamie_cs: Action items: 1) mira — prepare variant and load test script (+priming). 2) sam — set ACT-43 and burst buffer for canary. 3) leo — alerts + rollback hooks. 4) sarah — capture Helios feedback during canary, list top 5 critical prompts. We'll sync 9:15am PT in #customer-success for final go.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: helios-canary-1719991234 at 2024-06-05T16:30:00Z (canary window 30m). Owner: mira_eng.

mira_eng: I'll post the locust results CSV and a short summary in-thread after the run. Also will include a tiny sample of the priming payloads we used.

sam_ops: Ops will standby for quick capacity bump if spike tests push >85% GPU for 3m. Otherwise we let autoscale handle it.

sarah_cust: Important — I'll gather Helios success metrics (throughput, cost delta) and a brief note for the renewal team within 24h. If anything looks off, we'll flag immediately.

jamie_cs: Great. One more: capture feedback via short form (link) — will paste before the canary: https://rwd-infra.internal/helios-feedback. Keep responses concise.

leo_sre: I'll be monitoring logs and tracer. If we hit fallback, I'll post immediate status and open an incident channel.

mira_eng: Quick config snippet for priming: 

```
# priming script excerpt
POST /v1/cache/prime
{
  "model": "gptx-8k-quant:v2",
  "prompts": ["<top_prompt_1>", "<top_prompt_2>"]
}
```

jamie_cs: Perfect. See you all 9:15am PT in the channel. Thanks — let's make this smooth for the customer. :thumbsup:
